input.name: auto_solver
input.description: Solve board by constraint propagation and guesses
input.code: let v=game.view(), R=game.rows,C=game.cols; let steps=0; for(let z=0;z<500;z++){let safe=new Set(), mines=new Set(); for(let r=0;r<R;r++)for(let c=0;c<C;c++){let n=+v[r][c]; if(Number.isNaN(n))continue; let h=[],f=0; for(let [a,b] of game.neighbors(r,c)){if(v[a][b]=='#')h.push(a+','+b); if(v[a][b]=='F')f++} if(h.length&&n-f==0)h.forEach(x=>safe.add(x)); if(h.length&&n-f==h.length)h.forEach(x=>mines.add(x));} if(mines.size){for(let x of mines){let [r,c]=x.split(',').map(Number); if(v[r][c]=='#'){game.toggleFlag(r,c);steps++}}} else if(safe.size){for(let x of safe){let [r,c]=x.split(',').map(Number); if(game.view()[r][c]=='#'){let q=game.reveal(r,c);steps++; if(q.hitMine)return q}}} else {let q=null; outer:for(let r=0;r<R;r++)for(let c=0;c<C;c++)if(game.view()[r][c]=='#'){q=game.reveal(r,c);steps++;break outer} if(q&&q.hitMine)return q} v=game.view(); if(game.summary().status!='playing')break} return {...game.summary(),steps,board:game.text()};

input.code: let R=game.rows,C=game.cols,v=game.view(),steps=0;if(v.every(x=>x.every(y=>y=='#'))){let q=game.reveal(4,4);steps++;if(q.hitMine)return q;v=game.view()}for(let z=0;z<300;z++){let safe=new Set(),mines=new Set();for(let r=0;r<R;r++)for(let c=0;c<C;c++){let n=+v[r][c];if(Number.isNaN(n))continue;let h=[],f=0;for(let [a,b] of game.neighbors(r,c)){if(v[a][b]=='#')h.push(a+','+b);else if(v[a][b]=='F')f++}if(h.length&&n==f)h.forEach(x=>safe.add(x));if(h.length&&n-f==h.length)h.forEach(x=>mines.add(x))}if(mines.size)for(let x of mines){let [r,c]=x.split(',').map(Number);if(game.view()[r][c]=='#'){game.toggleFlag(r,c);steps++}}else if(safe.size)for(let x of safe){let [r,c]=x.split(',').map(Number);if(game.view()[r][c]=='#'){let q=game.reveal(r,c);steps++;if(q.hitMine)return q}}else break;v=game.view();if(game.summary().status!='playing')break}return {...game.summary(),steps,board:game.text()};
